claims.statement: For fixed finite states X, an observable signature s:X->S and target f:X->Y, f factors through s exactly when f is constant on every s-fiber. A full finite grouping certifies that property on X; two equal-signature states with different targets refute it.
dependencies: Fixed finite state rectangle, signature and target functions
Complete enumeration or explicit collision witness
claims.limits: Necessity follows by substitution; sufficiency defines the quotient function on each occupied signature. No actual foreign census or universal definability proof performed here.

findings.statement: G22 incorrectly says recorded bounded rounds are upper bounds on global fewest changes only if17:O3 is settled. findings.recommended_action: Keep the shortest-path lower/upper/equality obligations separate in any adapted workflow.
